correctness.rationale: Local torus coordinates reduce the sections to f_i=t_i, g_i=t_i², h_ij=t_i²t_j. Hasse jets satisfy h_ij−g_i−f_j=−1+2u_i u_j modulo degree3; yields 2n+binom(n,2) rank unless char2, then 2n+1. Translation preserves cubic polynomial independence; image of quadratic second fundamental map spanned by pure squares, so Frobenius function-field degree 2^(n−1). Independently built binomial-coefficient Hasse matrices n=2,3,4 giving char2 ranks 5,7,9 and odd ranks 5,9,14; n=2 rank and defect coincide in both characteristics; rank divergence starts at n=3.
residual_risks: Perkinson and general osculation theory may entail modular examples not explicitly searched through every appendix; n=2 positive-characteristic overlap is substantial. Hasse square map is not ordinary Hessian.
